description.value: Gleneagles Community Centre is a municipally operated recreation facility in the Gleneagles neighbourhood of West Vancouver, situated along Marine Drive near Howe Sound. Run by West Vancouver Municipality, it serves as a hub for local recreation programs and community gatherings. Its location on the scenic Marine Drive cycling corridor makes it a natural waypoint for touring cyclists passing through the area.
